title: Swoon'd Curriculum Unit File (split layout, contract 1.1)
description: docs/courses/<id>/curriculum/units/<NN>-<unit-id>.json. One unit (same object as curriculum.schema.json units[]) plus optional unit-local concepts merged into the course concept list.

concepts.description: Optional unit-local concepts, merged into the course concepts. A concept id defined in more than one file is an error.
